## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Risk classification

- [ ] No externally observable behaviour changes
- [ ] API or schema behaviour changes
- [ ] Ledger, balances, reservations or accounting changes
- [ ] Authentication, authorisation, policy or compliance changes
- [ ] Settlement, liquidity, pricing or smart-contract changes
- [ ] Database migration or persistence changes

## Compatibility

- [ ] No breaking API change
- [ ] OpenAPI/spec updated where behaviour changed
- [ ] Migration/deprecation path documented where required
- [ ] SDK/examples updated where required

## Verification

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Financial/state invariants remain satisfied
- [ ] Failure paths fail closed
- [ ] No secrets, production credentials or customer data included
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated where appropriate

## Evidence

Include commands run, test output, screenshots, traces, or other evidence that makes the change independently reviewable.
